connector.name: Feedhook MCP
connector.registryDescription: Turn a YouTube channel into a webhook: a signed HTTP POST seconds after every new video.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package feedhook-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the patwalls account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FEEDHOOK_API_KEY
env.description: Feedhook account API key (create one free via the create_account tool or POST https://feedhook.walls.sh/accounts)
